judgments.reason: Dataset is named for Wairagkar et al 2018 with the same DOI and authors; the paper reports the finger-tapping EEG recordings (14 subjects) that make up this data.
judgments.paper_title: Exploration of neural correlates of movement intention based on characterisation of temporal dependencies in electroencephalography

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to convert the dataset, not a paper describing this motor execution dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing this motor execution dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
